draft.inside_message: Happy anniversary to you and Sam. I'm very glad you found each other, and slightly jealous that Sam gets the good coffee before the market even opens. Have a lovely day, both of you.

artwork_brief.style_note: loose scattered sparks, hand-drawn feel, warm colours

draft.rationale: Leans on the anniversary with Sam and the coffee cart for a personal, teasing note from a lifelong friend, with no number named as the ordinal was ruled out.
